purpose: Keep goals, evidence and next actions aligned during complex work using an optional plan template and focused revisions.
trigger: Use when uncertainty, multiple next actions, or coordination makes a saved plan useful; simple questions may finish directly.
input_contract: Assigned host task context, inspected evidence, peer feedback, and current checkpoint; attached plan tools own the canonical content schema.
output_contract: Optional planning template and intent; save_plan creates, modify_plan edits, and read_plan retrieves canonical versioned checkpoints.
failure_handling: Preserve useful findings and limitations if planning is unavailable; inspect current revisions after stale rejection, respect ownership, and use existing work and dependency tools.
